page_title: LIV 1-1 SUN | Liverpool v Sunderland 03/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Stuart Attwell is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
90+7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+6' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+4' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
90+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+3' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Chemsdine Talbi will be replaced by Luke O'Nien (Sunderland).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
90' The corner kick from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
89' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
88' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) replaces Andrew Robertson.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexander Isak walks off the pitch to be replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
86' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) is able to continue to play.
85' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

81' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Robin Roefs. 1:1.
79' The game has come to an end for Enzo Le Fee. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
77' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals.
76' A cross into the box from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is cleared.
74' Trai Hume (Sunderland) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
74' Here is a change. Alexis Mac Allister is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool).
73' Trai Hume (Sunderland) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

72' What a poor attempt! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
71' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
70' 64:36 – the latest ball possession ratio.
67' 0 - 1 Goal! Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Alisson. 0:1.

67' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
65' The referee signals a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Joe Gomez.
64' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Roefs intercepts the ball.
62' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Brian Brobbey and he is replaced by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland).
62' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

61' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Omar Alderete (Sunderland) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
61' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) will take a corner kick.
61' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) plays a long ball to Brian Brobbey, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. Now Sunderland have a corner.
60' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.

59' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
58' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
56' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
55' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sees a yellow card from Stuart Attwell after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
55' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) trips an opposition player and Stuart Attwell signals a foul. Sunderland have been awarded a free kick.
54' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

54' The game is interrupted. Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Liverpool win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

46' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Stuart Attwell blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' Arne Slot makes a half-time substitution. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) comes on in place of Cody Gakpo.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) leaps high to meet a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but his header rattles the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
44' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.

43' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) hammers the ball towards the top left corner, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Robin Roefs, who denies him with a terrific save. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) is caught offside!
41' A raking crossfield pass from Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
39' Sunderland are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
36' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
34' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.

32' Trai Hume (Sunderland) lost the defenders marking him and unloaded a powerful hammer of a shot towards the roof of the net, but Alisson wasn't caught off guard and parried the ball onto the crossbar.

32' Well-positioned Omar Alderete (Sunderland) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
31' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Sunderland.
30' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
30' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
29' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
24' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) brings an opponent down and Stuart Attwell interrupts the game.

24' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
23' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.

19' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.

17' Trai Hume (Sunderland) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
16' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Stuart Attwell signals a set piece. Sunderland are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
16' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
16' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a long ball in, but Robin Roefs comfortably gathers the ball.
11' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range attempt straight to the middle of the goal.
9' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Half-chance! Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) plays a pass into the box, but Alisson reacts well to snuff out the attack.

5' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball is out of play. Sunderland will take a throw-in.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a long ball in, but Robin Roefs comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Stuart Attwell.
